jobs.title: Erfaren C#-utvecklare till Captech
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta nära användarna och ha stort utrymme att fatta tekniska beslut? Hos Captech ingår du i ett litet men erfaret utvecklingsteam som tillsammans formar lösningar och arbetssätt. Du bygger och vidareutvecklar affärskritiska system som används varje dag av hundratals personer inom företaget och av våra kunder.Captech är en av Nordens största elektronikdistributörer. Vi grundades år 1996 i Göteborg, då som en butik med expertis inom datorer och PC-produktion.
  
  
Sedan dess har vi haft en rejäl tillväxtresa, idag har vi kontor i Norge, Danmark och Finland, med huvudkontor och lager numera beläget i Mölndal. Vi tillhandahåller produkter inom IT, professionell Audio och Video, säkerhet och övervakning, samt konfigurationstjänster och PC-produktion. Våra kunder är enbart återförsäljare, både stora och små, främst i Norden men även i Europa. Captech har många grunder till sin framgång, en av dem är våra interna system och verktyg som får alla processer att lira.
  
  
Vi bestämde oss tidigt för att vi har bäst förutsättningar att göra ett bra arbete när våra verktyg är anpassade efter våra egna behov, därför har vi utvecklat majoriteten av våra system helt själva, in-house. Det innebär att våra utvecklare arbetar nära användarna, förstår affärsbehoven och har möjlighet att påverka lösningar.Om rollenBehoven i verksamheten växer och vi vill driva fler initiativ. Därför utökar vi utvecklingsavdelningen, som i dag består av fyra utvecklare och en chef. Du arbetar med både nya och befintliga system som är centrala för verksamheten.
  
  
Eftersom användarna finns nära får du snabb återkoppling på det du bygger.Här finns ingen särskild hierarki där någon annan redan har bestämt hur lösningarna ska se ut. Vi diskuterar lösningar i teamet och litar på varandras omdömen. Du behöver kunna fatta egna beslut och prova nya vägar. Det är också självklart att vi hjälps åt när det behövs.Några exempel på system vi ansvarar för: - Applikationer för sälj och inköp- Webshop- Kundintegrationer (API och EDI)- Integrationer mot lagersystem och speditörerVem vi sökerVi söker dig som är trygg i din kompetens och tar ansvar för att arbetet går framåt.
  
  
Du vågar fatta beslut och testa nya sätt, även när allt inte är givet från början. Du jobbar strukturerat, säger till när planen inte håller och samarbetar bra med både teamet och andra delar av organisationen.Du är van att arbeta enligt etablerade metoder för planering och uppföljning. Att testa och kvalitetssäkra det du bygger är en naturlig del av ditt arbete.Vi söker dig som har: - Ingenjörsexamen inom datateknik eller motsvarande utbildning- Minst fem års professionell erfarenhet av utveckling i C# och .NET- Gedigen erfarenhet av kvalitet och testning av egenutvecklad mjukvara- Erfarenhet av SQL- Erfarenhet av och förståelse för CI/CD- Erfarenhet av agila arbetsmetoderMeriterande erfarenheter: - ASP.NET och/eller WPF/XAML- DevOps och monitorering- Fullstackutveckling- AI-assisterad utveckling och AI-verktyg- Entity FrameworkHar du inte arbetat med desktopapplikationer tidigare kan du lära dig det hos oss.Teknisk miljöVi arbetar främst i Microsoft-miljö. Merparten av våra backendtjänster körs on-prem.Vår tekniska miljö: - Moderna versioner av .NET (8–10)- Git- Azure DevOps- MS SQL- ASP.NET- WPF/XAMLAtt jobba på CaptechPå Captech är vi måna om att våra medarbetare trivs och utvecklas.
  
  
Som utvecklare hos oss blir du en del av ett team med nära samarbete, korta beslutsvägar och stor möjlighet att påverka. Vi värdesätter nyfikenhet och lärande. Du uppmuntras även att utforska nya tekniker och arbetssätt, dela kunskap med teamet och vara med och påverka hur vi utvecklar våra system framåt.Vi arbetar från vårt kontor i Mölndal tre dagar i veckan, och två dagar i veckan finns möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån. Kontoret har goda förbindelser med kollektivtrafik, såväl som gott om parkeringsplatser inkl.
  
  
laddplatser för dig som åker bil.Villkor och förmånerDu omfattas av Handelns tjänstemannaavtal. Vi erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag, möjlighet att leasa förmånscykel och rabatter hos samarbetspartners och butiker.Varje nyanställning på Captech inleds med en provanställning.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Developer - TRATON Workshop Suite
jobs.description:
TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com

Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.

**Role Summary**
----------------

*This role is part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden.*

  

As a **Full-Stack Software Developer**, you will join Team Jaguar, one of several cross-functional development teams working together to build the **TRATON Workshop Suite (TWS)** – the digital workshop platform supporting technicians in servicing, maintaining and updating vehicles across the TRATON Group.

  

Team Jaguar is responsible for the **Software Update domain**, developing user-facing functionality that enables workshop technicians to safely and efficiently update vehicle software. The team owns the functionality and user experience end-to-end, from the workshop application through backend and cloud services. To deliver the complete solution, we collaborate closely with other TWS teams and use shared capabilities such as product and vehicle communication services.

  

In this role, you will work across the full technology stack, primarily using **C#/.NET, AWS and Angular** in a microservice-based architecture. The solutions you develop are ultimately used by workshop technicians in their daily work, giving the role a clear connection between the technology we build and the value it creates for our users.

  

You will be part of a team with shared responsibility for building, operating and continuously improving stable, secure and user-friendly solutions that support efficient workshop operations across the TRATON Group.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and maintain **full-stack functionality within the Software Update domain**, using C#/.NET, AWS and Angular across frontend, backend, microservices and APIs;
* Build robust and user-friendly solutions that enable **safe and reliable software updates of vehicles**;
* Take part in the complete software lifecycle – from requirements, design and implementation to testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, support and maintenance;
* Collaborate closely with developers, testers, Product Owner and Scrum Master within the team, as well as with other teams across TWS;
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues across frontend, backend, cloud services and integrations;
* Continuously improve system stability, observability, maintainability, quality and user experience;
* Contribute to testing and validation in development environments, rigs and real vehicles;
* Contribute actively to the team's way of working, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

**Who You Are**
---------------

We believe you are a collaborative and curious full-stack software developer who enjoys solving real problems for end users and understanding the complete solution.

  

You have **at least 3 years of relevant professional experience** and a solid foundation in software development. You don't need to have worked with every technology in our stack – what matters is that you have relevant experience, enjoy learning and can contribute effectively as part of a team.

  

You have experience with **C#/.NET, cloud development such as AWS and microservice architectures**, combined with frontend development. **Experience with Angular is preferred**, while experience with other modern frontend frameworks, such as React, is also valuable.

  

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend development, but you should be comfortable working across both and willing to contribute wherever the team needs you.

  

For us, technical competence is only part of what makes a great developer. **How you collaborate, communicate and contribute to the team is equally important.** We are looking for someone who enjoys working closely with others, shares knowledge, asks for help when needed and actively helps others succeed. We value shared ownership and believe that the best results are achieved together.

  

You are comfortable communicating with different audiences – from discussing technical details with fellow developers to explaining complex technical topics to stakeholders with different levels of technical knowledge. You can adapt your communication to your audience, making complex topics understandable without losing what is important. You listen to different perspectives and seek to understand the needs behind what we build.

  

You take initiative and ownership while staying aligned with the team. You are curious about the customer and want to understand not only **how** something should be built, but **why it matters to the people using it**.

  

Experience within automotive software, vehicle communication, distributed systems, DevOps, observability or similar technically complex environments is considered an advantage, but not a requirement. Most importantly, you are motivated to learn the domain, contribute to the team and grow together with us.

  

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and value different experiences and perspectives. **If you are excited about the role but don't meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply.**

**This Is Us**
--------------

**Team Jaguar** is a cross-functional team of developers and testers responsible for the **Software Update domain within the TRATON Workshop Suite**.

  

Our solutions enable workshop technicians to perform software updates on vehicles, making our work both technically challenging and directly connected to the end-user experience. We develop across frontend, backend and cloud services and collaborate closely with other TWS teams whose capabilities together enable the complete workshop solution.

  

Jaguar is one of several teams that together develop the TRATON Workshop Suite. We have clear ownership of our domain while depending on and contributing to the wider TWS ecosystem. Close collaboration across team boundaries is therefore a natural part of how we work.

  

Within Jaguar, we work closely together and share responsibility for what we build and operate. **Different experiences, perspectives and strengths make the team better**, and we help each other solve problems, share knowledge and learn along the way. We want an environment where people feel comfortable asking questions, contributing ideas and challenging existing solutions constructively.

  

We strive to work in an **agile and iterative way**, with close collaboration, shared ownership and continuous improvement. As a team, we plan, build, evaluate, learn and adjust together, continuously looking for ways to improve both our solutions and how we work.

  

Joining Team Jaguar means becoming part of a collaborative team where you can work across the full technology stack, **broaden your skills across frontend, backend and cloud development**, and contribute to solutions with a clear impact on workshop operations.

  

As part of the wider **TRATON Workshop Suite development organization**, you will also be exposed to different technical domains, technologies and challenges, creating opportunities to broaden your experience and continue developing over time. You will have opportunities to learn from others, share your own expertise and grow together with the team as we continue developing the TRATON Workshop Suite.

**TRATON Offers**
-----------------

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

  

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

  

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

**Application**
---------------

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

  

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-19. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check is required for this role.

If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Mattias Gustafsson, Unit Head - System Development Service Products - TGROSDS, mattias.gustafsson@scania.com

  

**We look forward to your application!**

  

*This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON Group**R&D.*

jobs.title: .Net Developer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a **.NET Developer** to join our established application development teams and help deliver high‑quality web applications and APIs for key clients.

You’ll work across the Microsoft technology stack, collaborate with designers, leads, and architects, and contribute to the full development lifecycle in a fast‑paced enterprise environment.

**What You’ll Do:**

* + Develop and maintain .NET web applications and REST APIs using C#, ASP.NET, MVC, Entity Framework and related technologies.
  + Work closely with functional design teams, technical leads, and architects to translate requirements into robust solutions.
  + Apply strong engineering standards including clean code practices, SOLID principles, TDD and DDD.
  + Work with SQL Server on database design, scripting, and performance optimisation.
  + Integrate third‑party and open‑source components into .NET applications.
  + Use CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tools such as GitHub and Azure DevOps.
  + Support Agile ceremonies, contribute to planning, estimating, and code reviews.
  + Produce clear documentation for system changes and provide support to junior developers where needed.
  + Deliver quality code within tight timelines

  

**What You’ll Bring:**

  

* + Strong experience with C#, ASP.NET, MVC, Linq, Entity Framework (VB.NET a plus).
  + Experience building and configuring RESTful APIs.
  + Good knowledge of JavaScript frameworks and CSS.
  + Solid SQL Server experience (design, scripting, optimisation).
  + Familiarity with DevOps tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and package management.
  + Experience with automated testing frameworks (MSTest, NUnit, xUnit, Moq, etc.).
  + Strong understanding of OO design, async programming, and multi‑threading.
  + Excellent communication skills and comfort engaging with multiple stakeholders.
  + Experience in Agile delivery; consulting experience is an advantage.
  + Experience with GitHub Copilot or similar tools is a bonus.

jobs.title: Graduate Engineer - Service & Repairs Department
jobs.description:
**About the role:**

If you are a graduate of mechanical, electrical, civil or automation engineering and you're ready for responsibility and autonomy, while being supported by a team of experienced peers, look no further!

We are **now recruiting** an engineering graduate to join our busy Service and Repairs Division based in Mallow, Co. Cork.

As part of our ever growing team, you will be responsible for the engineering activities on municipal and industrial wastewater treatment plants, drinking water treatment plants and various pumping stations.

No two days will be the same, so your activities will vary and will be agreed with the Project Co-Ordinator on an ongoing basis. You will support the co-ordinators and wider team through the process up to and including the onsite service and repairs element of our works including managing SLA's.

A highly varied, challenging role providing invaluable exposure to the right candidate.

**So fast track your career with us!**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Project management of water & wastewater pumping and treatment installations
* Assist in procurement of all items for projects and SLA's including labour, parts and materials
* Timeline planning of installations from repairs and maintenance, awarding of contract to completion and handover of all documentation including service level agreements
* Assist in management of site labour for projects
* Ensuring the project is completed on time
* Writing engineering reports, method statements, risk assessments and commissioning schedules
* Responsible for O&M, health & safety documentation and assist with enforcement of safe work practices onsite during all EPS installation

**Key Competencies and Skills:**

* Proficiency in PC skills to include MS office and Project software is advantageous
* Good inter-personal and communication skills
* Strong engineering, analytical and problem-solving skills
* Strong collaborative skills with an ability to work effectively in a team environment
* Have a willingness to learn and be challenged in the water and wastewater Industry
* Interest in implementing opportunities and initiatives in a time restricted schedule
* Develop specific goals and plans to prioritise, organise and accomplish stated deadlines

**Qualifications:**

* Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil or Automation Engineering
* Strong communication skills and an enthusiasm about working in a highly driven team
* Full EU/ Irish driving licence

**Compensation Package:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Robust graduate programme
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth
* CPD accredited employer
* A collaborative and supportive work environment
* Laptop or desktop and work mobile phone provided
* Flexible working options, dependent on location and role requirements
* Opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment and develop within the team
* See company website for more information on the benefits of working in EPS Group

We welcome speculative applications from individuals of all levels.

**Equal Opportunity Statement** - EPS Group is an equal opportunities employer.

**Company Profile**

*Since 1968, we have grown from a modest electrical and pumping services business and developed into an innovative, internationally exporting product and service provider, now focused upon the water, wastewater and clean technology sectors, operating across the Republic of Ireland, the UK and Northern Europe.*

*We are an international water infrastructure specialist, one of the few genuine end-to-end service providers in the global water sector, providing large scale employment, bringing market leading and ground breaking technologies to Ireland and working to improve the country's water infrastructure.*

*Our vision is to be the best and most rewarding place to work for our teams, to be our customer's outstanding partner of choice and we are committed to being a Net Zero, sustainable business.*
